branchApplicability.rationale: USDh has no borrower-specific collateral or liquidation branches, but Hermetica's protocol-wide risk engine values BTC assets and perpetual hedges, continuously reconciles them against liabilities, and may pause redemption when price feeds cannot support accurate valuation.
